## Summary

This doctoral research combined **data analysis and operations research** to solve problems arising in the context of Industry 4.0. It focused on **nearest-neighbour (k-NN) algorithms** and their variants: how weighting the features of a distance, computed by linear programming, can improve predictive performance, and how predictive and computational performance depend on the characteristics of the models and of the datasets.

The aim was to identify, in a comparative way, the conditions under which each algorithm is best suited to a given context.
